text:
Established in 2014, our story began with hope and a vision – to work alongside you and the greater medical community to provide as many people as possible, with the best in rehabilitation solutions.

James graduated from the University of the Sunshine Coast with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours). He is passionate about supporting clients to overcome barriers related to injury, disease, or disability through goal setting, equipment prescription, and task-oriented rehabilitation.

He has a strong interest in neurological conditions, particularly stroke and upper limb rehabilitation post-stroke. James enjoys delivering innovative interventions to improve both physical and cognitive functioning across a range of client groups.

He is committed to providing effective rehabilitation strategies and environmental modifications that enable clients to participate more fully in meaningful activities at home and within their communities.

Outside of work, he enjoys travelling, cooking for friends, and exploring the Sunshine Coast hinterland.

James is available for mobile occupational therapy consults throughout Brisbane.

Emily graduated from Loughborough University in the United Kingdom in June 2012, achieving a first-class honours degree in Sports and Exercise Science. She then completed a Level 5 BTEC Professional Diploma in Clinical Sport and Remedial Massage Therapy at the London School of Sports Massage, qualifying in August 2013. She is also a qualified practitioner in advanced dry needling.

She has worked as a sports and remedial massage therapist within physiotherapy clinics in the United Kingdom. Her clinical experience also includes working with British Triathlon at their base in Loughborough, where she travelled internationally to training camps and European and World Triathlon events, supporting injury prevention and recovery. She has also worked as the primary massage therapist for the Loughborough Students Elite Rugby Union Team, competing in National League 1.

Outside of work, she enjoys staying active and being involved in sporting environments.

Emily is available for mobile remedial massage consults across the Sunshine Coast.

Josh graduated from La Trobe University with a Bachelor of Health Science and a Master of Physiotherapy Practice.

He has extensive experience working in private practice across a range of caseloads, including musculoskeletal, orthopaedic, and neurological conditions. In 2021, Josh moved to the Sunshine Coast and transitioned into a community therapy role with Team Rehab Solutions. He has a strong interest in persistent pain, neurological conditions, and exercise-based rehabilitation.

He enjoys collaborating with clients to help them achieve their goals and takes pride in making rehabilitation engaging, fun, and purposeful.

Outside of work, he enjoys spending time outdoors, staying active, and travelling whenever the opportunity arises.

Josh is available for mobile physiotherapy consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Joe is an exercise physiologist with a passion for working collaboratively with patients to achieve their goals. He has completed a Master’s degree in Neurological Rehabilitation and undertaken extended research in neurology and pain science.

He has also completed further specialised training in Parkinson’s disease, functional neurological disorder, stroke, and persistent pain. Joe is committed to evidence-based practice and supporting clients to improve function, independence, and quality of life.

Joe is available for mobile exercise physiology consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Luke is an experienced podiatrist with over 14 years in private practice and two years of rural experience with Queensland Health. He has also volunteered with the Queensland Podiatry Board and was appointed president in 2017, contributing to the profession at an industry level. This breadth of experience has helped him develop a strong reputation as a caring and trustworthy practitioner.

He enjoys all aspects of podiatry, including mechanical assessment, sports injuries, ingrown toenails, and plantar warts, and is passionate about helping patients resolve foot-related concerns.

Luke holds a Bachelor of Science (Podiatry) from QUT and a Bachelor of Sport and Exercise Science, reflecting his interest in sports injury management and prevention.

Born and raised on the Sunshine Coast, he enjoys sports, camping, and the outdoors. He is a keen golfer and enjoys coaching his children’s soccer teams.

Luke is available for mobile podiatry consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Hayden is a qualified occupational therapist who graduated from the University of the Sunshine Coast. He has previously worked within the community as an allied health assistant and has enjoyed supporting individuals to achieve their goals.

He has a special interest in paediatrics, upper limb therapy, and the use of assistive technology. Hayden values building strong rapport with clients and working collaboratively to help them achieve meaningful outcomes.

Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with family and friends, going on adventures and trying new experiences, and playing basketball.

Hayden is available for mobile occupational therapy consults on the Sunshine Coast and in Gympie.

Abbey graduated from the University of the Sunshine Coast with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours).

Abbey is a dedicated occupational therapist with a passion for community care and supporting individuals to live fulfilling lives. She is committed to a client-centred approach, empowering clients to achieve goals that are important to them. Abbey has a special interest in falls risk prevention, assistive technology, and mental health.

Abbey strives to inspire clients by providing high-quality, individualised, and evidence-based care tailored to their specific needs.

Outside of work, Abbey enjoys travelling, practising yoga, and going to the beach.

Abbey is available for mobile occupational therapy consults across Brisbane.

Marty graduated from the University of Queensland with a Master’s degree in Physiotherapy in 2004.

He has extensive clinical experience across hospital, outpatient, and community settings, working with a wide range of presentations including neurological conditions (stroke, Parkinson’s disease, neurosurgery), spinal surgery, respiratory conditions (COPD, bronchiectasis), cardiac conditions (heart failure, post-heart attack rehabilitation), musculoskeletal injuries (sports injuries, low back pain, shoulder and neck pain), orthopaedic rehabilitation (joint replacements, knee and shoulder reconstructions), men’s health (post-prostatectomy), falls prevention, and cancer care.

He is committed to placing clients at the centre of care and supporting them to achieve their individual goals through tailored rehabilitation programs.

Outside of work, he enjoys staying active and spending time in the community.

Marty is available for mobile physiotherapy consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Tara is an exercise physiologist who values building meaningful, professional relationships with clients and takes a collaborative approach to care and rehabilitation to support the best possible outcomes.

She has developed a particular interest in neurological rehabilitation, as well as working with paediatric and mental health clients. Tara has completed personal development courses in neurological rehabilitation and persistent pain.

She is passionate about supporting clients with neurological rehabilitation, persistent pain, paediatrics, and mental health presentations through individualised, evidence-based care.

Outside of work, she enjoys staying active and continuing her professional development in exercise physiology.

Tara is available for mobile exercise physiology appointments on the Sunshine Coast.

Jacob completed his Diploma of Remedial Massage in early 2022. Prior to his studies in remedial therapy, he studied at the University of the Sunshine Coast, where he obtained a Diploma in Sport Science. He is a current member of Massage & Myotherapy Australia.

Jacob’s main goal is to treat clients and teach massage techniques so they can reduce pain and tension at home and support their own ongoing wellbeing.

Outside of work, he enjoys surfing, mountain biking, and playing golf with friends and family.

Jacob is available for mobile remedial massage consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Chyanne completed a master’s degree in Clinical Exercise Physiology at Southern Cross University on the Gold Coast. From a young age, she developed a strong interest in neurological rehabilitation, which led her to a career in exercise physiology and supporting people to reach their optimal function.

She enjoys thinking outside the box when prescribing exercise, creating tailored programs specific to each individual’s goals, whether that is improving mobility, function, or overall health.

Outside of work, she enjoys listening to live music, spending time with friends and family, and chasing sunsets.

Chyanne is available for mobile exercise physiology consults across the Gold Coast.

Rhys is an Accredited Exercise Physiologist with a Bachelor of Human Movement and a Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology from the University of South Australia. He has worked in remote Aboriginal communities in the Alice Springs region as well as in private practice clinics.

He is passionate about providing an enjoyable service that fosters an appreciation of exercise and supports lifelong behaviour change to improve health outcomes. Rhys enjoys all areas of exercise physiology and has a particular interest in neurological conditions.

Outside of work, he enjoys reading, gaming, and spending time with his dog.

Rhys is available for mobile exercise physiology consults in Brisbane.

Emily hails from Townsville and completed her Occupational Therapy degree at James Cook University. She has a strong interest in neurological conditions, including both stable and degenerative presentations, and supporting individuals to achieve independence through environmental modifications, assistive technology, and therapy-based interventions.

Emily primarily works within the NDIS space and has been supporting participants since the scheme’s rollout in South East Queensland. She also has experience working with DVA and Home Care Package clients, and predominantly supports adults with neurological and physical conditions.

Her background includes community-based practice, as well as experience within the Australian Public Service as an NDIS planner and occupational therapist within the NDIA technical advisory team. She has experience in assistive technology prescription, home modifications, neurological rehabilitation, and NDIS reporting, including SIL and SDA.

Outside of work, she enjoys spending time in her garden with her two border collies or relaxing with a good book.

Emily is available for mobile occupational therapy appointments across the Sunshine Coast.

Larissa is a proud Sunshine Coast local who graduated from the University of the Sunshine Coast with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours). She is passionate about providing holistic support to help clients engage in meaningful activities, maximise independence, and improve overall quality of life.

She values building strong therapeutic relationships and working collaboratively to ensure personalised, client-centred care. Larissa has a keen interest in equipment prescription, upper limb neurological rehabilitation, minor home modifications, and supporting older adults to remain safe and independent.

Outside of work, she enjoys exploring local waterfall walks, completing 1000-piece puzzles, attending Pilates, reading novels, and spending time with family and friends.

Larissa is available for mobile occupational therapy consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Originally from Bribie Island, Caitlyn completed a Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology at the University of the Sunshine Coast. She also holds a Diploma in Sports Development, which has further strengthened her understanding of a range of health and performance solutions.

Growing up, she had a strong passion for sport, particularly AFL and netball, which she has combined with her commitment to helping others through exercise physiology.

She is focused on providing the best possible care to clients day in and day out and has a particular interest in neurological rehabilitation and paediatrics.

Outside of work, she enjoys staying active and maintaining her involvement in sports and fitness.

Caitlyn is available for mobile exercise physiology consults on the Fraser Coast.

Emily graduated from the Auckland University of Technology in New Zealand with a Bachelor of Health Science, majoring in Physiotherapy. She has a strong desire to help people achieve positive outcomes within the community.

She is passionate about person-centred care and building strong therapeutic relationships. Emily is committed to supporting clients to improve their quality of life and achieve their individual goals.

Outside of work, she enjoys camping, reading, and spending time with friends and family.

Emily is available for mobile physiotherapy consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Caitlin is an Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) who completed her Bachelor of Dietetics at the University of the Sunshine Coast. She has many years of experience in private practice supporting clients with a wide range of nutrition concerns across the coast.

Caitlin has a strong interest in paediatric nutrition and eating disorder management, and regularly undertakes additional training in these areas. She has completed a Certificate of Paediatric Nutrition and Dietetics through the Royal Children’s Hospital in Melbourne and is a qualified SOS Feeding Therapist.

She is passionate about supporting even the youngest clients to develop lifelong skills for optimal nutrition and a positive relationship with food. Caitlin works closely with clients, their families, and carers, taking great pride in improving both the client’s experience with food and the wider support network involved in their care. She has experience supporting paediatric clients with ASD, ADHD, fussy eating, sensory processing difficulties, faltering growth, global developmental delay, eating disorders, cerebral palsy, and more. She also supports clients requiring enteral or parenteral nutrition (tube feeding).

Caitlin also has a special interest in eating disorder management and works with clients across the lifespan to improve their relationship with food and support recovery. She takes an individualised, compassionate approach, recognising that conversations around food and nutrition can be challenging, and works at each client’s pace.

Caitlin is available for in-home dietitian consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Jemma Riddiford graduated from Queensland University of Technology in 2010 with a Bachelor of Health Science (Podiatry) with Honours. She is registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) and is a member of the Australian Podiatry Association (APodA). She has worked in private practice, hospitals, and aged care facilities, transitioning to her current role as a community podiatrist 10 years ago.

She is passionate about community-based care and values the opportunity to build strong relationships with patients while supporting them in the comfort of their own homes. She enjoys working with people across all ages and backgrounds and finds great satisfaction in making a meaningful difference in their lives.

Outside of work, she enjoys travelling, gardening, and discovering new restaurants with friends and family.

Jemma is available for mobile podiatry appointments across Brisbane.

Abbey graduated with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours) from the University of the Sunshine Coast.

Abbey is a dedicated occupational therapist committed to a holistic and client-centred approach, supporting individuals to achieve their goals. She has a special interest in chronic pain, neurological conditions, and the use of assistive technology to enhance independence and quality of life.

Abbey places a strong emphasis on building meaningful rapport with her clients, fostering trust and collaboration as the foundation of effective therapy.

Outside of work, Abbey enjoys spending time with her friends and family, visiting the beach, and cooking in the kitchen.

Abbey is available for in-home occupational therapy consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Tessa has both a Diploma in Beauty Therapy and a Diploma in Remedial Massage, now a member of the Massage Association of Australia.

She is passionate about realistic and sustainable health and wellbeing and is committed to making a positive impact on her clients’ health and overall quality of life.

Outside of work, she enjoys going for long walks in the sunshine, visiting the movies, and attending as many concerts as possible.

Tessa is available for mobile remedial massage therapy across the Sunshine Coast.

Courtney is an Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) with over 10 years of experience in the healthcare field, having worked extensively across both hospital and community settings. She completed a Bachelor’s Degree in Health Science (Nutrition and Dietetics) in 2011 and has since been dedicated to supporting individuals to achieve their health and nutrition goals.

Courtney has a particular focus on chronic disease management, weight loss and weight gain, and supporting individuals with disabilities. She is committed to making a positive impact on her clients’ lives and takes pride in fostering a healthy and positive relationship with food.

Outside of work, she enjoys spending time at the beach, camping, dining out, travelling overseas, and making memories with family and friends.

Courtney is available for dietitian consults across the Sunshine Coast and Gympie.

Tim graduated from the University of the Sunshine Coast with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours). Born and raised on the Sunshine Coast, he transitioned from a career in construction, where he worked as a cabinet maker, into occupational therapy in pursuit of a more rewarding and fulfilling career.

He is passionate about helping people achieve their goals in recovery and breaking down barriers that may be in their way. Tim values the client–therapist relationship highly and prioritises building strong rapport with the people he works with to support positive outcomes.

He is committed to ongoing learning to better support his clients and achieve the best possible outcomes. Tim has a special interest in mental health and complex home modifications.

Outside of work, he enjoys spending time outdoors and has recently developed a love for reading.

Tim is available for mobile occupational therapy consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Katie graduated from the Australian Catholic University in Melbourne with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy. She has experience working as a disability support worker, where she developed expertise in assistive technology, manual handling, and supporting individuals with spinal cord injuries.

She is passionate about empowering individuals to live meaningful and fulfilling lives through high-quality, person-centred, evidence-based care. Katie has a special interest in falls prevention, home modifications, and post-surgical rehabilitation.

Having relocated to the Sunshine Coast from central Victoria, she has embraced the coastal lifestyle and warmer weather. Outside of work, she enjoys beach outings, socialising with friends, playing netball, and going on adventures with her dog Opie.

Katie’s empathetic nature underpins her occupational therapy approach, ensuring care is tailored to each individual’s unique journey.

Katie is available for mobile occupational therapy consults throughout the Sunshine Coast and Gympie.

Ripley graduated with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (Honours) from the University of the Sunshine Coast. She is passionate about community care, particularly supporting individuals to increase independence in meaningful daily activities. Ripley values a client-centred approach and works closely with clients to ensure their goals are understood and achieved.

She is a skilled communicator who takes pride in building strong rapport with clients through a warm and empathetic approach. Ripley is committed to keeping clients well-informed throughout their therapeutic journey. Her clinical interests include assistive technology prescription, minor home modifications, and falls prevention.

Originally from the Sunshine Coast, she has a strong appreciation for the outdoors and enjoys swimming at the beach, hiking, and spending time in nature.

Ripley is available for mobile occupational therapy appointments on the Sunshine Coast and in Gympie.

Renee is passionate about providing client-centred services to support clients in developing and achieving goals that are meaningful to them. She strives to build strong rapport with clients and their support networks to foster long-lasting therapeutic relationships with clients and stakeholders alike.

She has a keen interest in mental health, daily living skills, minor home modifications, and assistive technology. Renee is a practical and empathetic practitioner who enjoys connecting with people from all walks of life.

Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with family and friends and relaxing in the garden with a good coffee.

Renee is available for occupational therapy consults throughout Brisbane.

Originally from the hills of north-east Victoria, Nicole relocated to the Sunshine Coast for the sun, sand, and warmer weather. She graduated with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy from Charles Sturt University.

She has experience working within the NDIS, supporting participant independence through holistic interventions and assistive technology prescription.

Nicole is passionate about providing holistic, evidence-based, client-centred care, supporting each individual to work towards their goals and improve safety, independence, and engagement in meaningful activities.

She enjoys sharing the value of occupational therapy with people of all ages and backgrounds and has developing interests in mental health, neurodevelopmental, and neurological conditions.

Outside of work, she enjoys stand-up paddleboarding on local waterways, spending time with friends and family, and challenging herself with gym classes or jigsaw puzzles.

Nicole is available for occupational therapy consults across the Sunshine Coast and Gympie.

Mitch holds a Diploma in Remedial Massage. He has worked within large multidisciplinary clinic settings and also gained experience providing sports massage for elite men’s and women’s teams, including the Fremantle Dockers, Western Force, Perth Glory, and Perth Wildcats, as well as world-class women’s tennis players during the United Cup.

These experiences have shaped his clinical approach, allowing him to confidently treat both referred clients in a multidisciplinary setting and athletes with a wide range of needs.

He enjoys working with clients of all levels who take their sport, fitness, or health journey seriously and shares this same philosophy in his own approach to health and wellbeing. His techniques include deep tissue, trigger point therapy, relaxation, and sports massage.

Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with his young family, his Border Collie, and competing in endurance sports.

Mitch is available for mobile remedial massage appointments on the Sunshine Coast.

Jarryd has over 10 years of experience as a remedial massage therapist. During this time, he has worked with a wide range of clients, from world-class and Olympic athletes through to weekend warriors. As a former track and field athlete and coach, he is passionate about encouraging people to be the best they can be.

Outside of work, he enjoys staying active and maintaining his connection to sport and performance.

Jarryd is available for remedial massage consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Jamieson graduated from the University of the Sunshine Coast with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy in 2016. She moved to Brisbane and developed a passion for working as a community occupational therapist, particularly within the geriatric neurological space. She understands the importance of building rapport with individuals and their families to support holistic, person-centred interventions that achieve meaningful goals in the home and community.

She has experience across functional and cognitive assessments, geriatric rehabilitation, minor and major home modifications, manual handling, equipment prescription, and assistive technology.

Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, staying active at the gym, surfing, and walking her dog Luna.

Jamieson is available for occupational therapy consults throughout the Sunshine Coast region.

Jy completed a Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology at the University of the Sunshine Coast. Since graduating, he has worked across both clinical and occupational rehabilitation settings, supporting clients through a range of return-to-work services.

He is committed to providing a safe, supportive, and encouraging environment, working closely with clients to break down barriers and progress towards their goals, whether big or small.

Outside of work, he enjoys training at the gym, playing AFL for the Maroochydore Roos, surfing, and searching for the next best camp spot.

Jy is available for in-home exercise physiology consults across the Sunshine Coast region.

Christina is currently a third-year occupational therapy student at the University of the Sunshine Coast.

She enjoys connecting with people from diverse backgrounds, hearing their stories, creating a safe space, and supporting individuals to achieve their personal goals.

Outside of work and study, she enjoys surfing in the ocean and taking walks in nature to relax and recharge.

Christina is available for allied health assistance throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Jess is a dedicated exercise physiologist driven by a passion for empowering clients to reach their full potential through exercise as medicine, promoting independence and overall wellbeing. She focuses on delivering client-centred care, fostering a safe and supportive environment, and working collaboratively with clients to achieve their goals and improve quality of life.

Originally from New Zealand, Jess moved to the Sunshine Coast to further her studies while embracing the coastal lifestyle and warmer climate. She has clinical experience in orthopaedic and musculoskeletal rehabilitation, with a growing interest in neurological rehabilitation. Jess is committed to ongoing learning and professional development to ensure the best possible care and treatment outcomes for her clients.

Outside of work, she enjoys staying active, whether at the gym, exploring hiking trails, or participating in water sports such as wakeboarding, surfing, and swimming.

Jess is available for mobile exercise physiology consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Jimmy graduated from the University of Queensland with a Bachelor of Physiotherapy (Honours) in 2019.

Since then, he has worked across a range of clinical areas, including musculoskeletal care in private practice, sports physiotherapy, chronic pain management, and community care, where he has found his passion. He has been working in the community space since 2022 and particularly enjoys supporting clients with neurological conditions, including traumatic brain injury, stroke, spinal cord injury, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson’s disease, and motor neurone disease.

He has completed several post-graduate courses, including further study in neurological physiotherapy through the Australian Physiotherapy Association, ARCAdemy’s masterclass on spasticity, and the University of Tasmania’s traumatic brain injury course.

He is passionate about helping clients achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes and increasing their independence.

Outside of work, he enjoys surfing, golf, and travelling whenever he can to go snowboarding.

Jimmy is available for mobile physiotherapy consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Anna graduated with a Bachelor of Physiotherapy (Honours) from Griffith University, developing a strong foundation in musculoskeletal, cardiorespiratory, and neurological rehabilitation. Her honours research focused on behaviour change, specifically habit formation in exercise maintenance, highlighting her commitment to integrating evidence-based strategies into practical physiotherapy applications.

Anna has a keen interest in working with the geriatric population and is dedicated to improving quality of life through tailored rehabilitation programs that promote physical independence and empowerment.

Outside of work, Anna enjoys engaging in research, gaming, reading novels, playing volleyball, and exploring her creativity through digital art.

Anna is available for in-home physiotherapy consults throughout Brisbane.

Jodie graduated from Cardiff University in Wales in 2021 with a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy, followed by a Master’s degree in Occupational Therapy. Prior to qualifying as an occupational therapist, Jodie worked as a mental health support worker in a supported living environment.

Jodie has experience working across inpatient and community-based settings. These experiences have fostered a strong interest in mental health, adult learning disabilities, and stroke rehabilitation.

She is passionate about empowering clients to overcome barriers, achieve their occupational goals, and maximise independence to support both mental and physical wellbeing.

Recently relocated to Australia from South Wales, she is enjoying exploring the local scenery and sunny lifestyle. Outside of work, she enjoys Pilates, beach walks with her dog, and catching up with friends and family over coffee.

Jodie is available for in-home occupational therapy consults throughout the Gold Coast.

Noee graduated from Monash University in Melbourne and has since worked across private practice, rehabilitation hospital, and community physiotherapy settings. She is passionate about helping people achieve their health goals and is always looking for modern and creative ways to support the rehabilitation process.

She has a keen interest in managing dizziness, vertigo, and balance disorders, supporting clients to restore confidence and independence at home. Noee has also completed the Vestibular Dysfunction and Management Clinical Competency Course.

Outside of work, she enjoys playing water polo, attending Pilates classes, and spending time at the beach.

Noee is available for physiotherapy appointments throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Lachlan is currently studying a Bachelor of Physiotherapy at the Australian Catholic University. He has several years of experience in allied health support and has developed a strong interest in musculoskeletal rehabilitation and exercise-based therapy. He enjoys learning from other allied health professionals to broaden his skills and knowledge across different areas of practice.

He is passionate about delivering person-centred care and takes pride in building strong, supportive relationships with clients as they work towards their goals. Lachlan aims to create a positive and encouraging environment that empowers individuals to improve their mobility, independence, and overall wellbeing.

Outside of his studies, he enjoys playing competitive hockey, getting out on the golf course, and spending time with his girlfriend and their two dogs.

Lachlan is available for allied health assistance throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Tarla is originally from the Central Coast, NSW, and has always had a strong passion for health, movement, and the outdoors. She completed her Diploma of Remedial Massage and has since expanded her expertise with a Certificate IV in Allied Health (Physiotherapy). She is a member of the Association of Massage Therapists and brings a well-rounded approach to supporting clients on their health and wellness journey.

Now based on the Sunshine Coast, Tarla is a devoted mum to three energetic boys and is happily married to her teenage sweetheart. Outside of her professional life, she enjoys camping with family and friends and spending sunny afternoons at the beach. Her warm, down-to-earth nature and commitment to helping others move and feel better make her a trusted practitioner.

Tarla is available for in-home remedial massage consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Joyce is a speech pathologist providing client-centred care. She is available for speech pathology consults throughout Brisbane.

Please contact us for more information about our speech pathology services.

Georgia is an Accredited Practising Dietitian, completing her Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics at Griffith University on the Gold Coast. She is committed to ensuring clients feel supported and empowered throughout their journey to better health through nutrition.

She uses evidence-based practice to tailor nutrition strategies to each client’s individual goals. Georgia has a special interest in weight management, cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and gastrointestinal health.

Outside of work, she enjoys continuing to expand her knowledge in nutrition and supporting people to build sustainable, healthy habits.

Georgia is available for in-home dietitian consults throughout Brisbane.

Simona is a Hervey Bay local and is currently studying occupational therapy. She has a background in sport studies and business management and is gaining ongoing experience across private practice, rehabilitation hospital, and community service settings.

She has a particular interest in paediatrics and community-based care and is dedicated to providing personalised, evidence-based support to help clients achieve greater independence.

Simona is passionate about building her career in healthcare and continues to develop her understanding of the diverse roles within allied health.

Simona is available for allied health assistant consults throughout the Fraser Coast.

Josh is a Sunshine Coast local and a graduate of the University of the Sunshine Coast, where he completed a Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology. Since graduating, he has gained experience working across neurological, cardiovascular, respiratory, and musculoskeletal conditions in both clinic-based and home visit settings.

With a lifelong background in sport, Josh has a strong interest in musculoskeletal rehabilitation. He also finds great fulfilment in supporting clients living with neurological, cardiovascular, and respiratory conditions, and in seeing the progress that consistent, evidence-based exercise can achieve.

He takes genuine enjoyment in helping clients reach their goals and believes in a client-centred approach that focuses on motivation, consistency, and tailored rehabilitation pathways for each individual.

Outside of work, he enjoys spending time with family, playing sports, and catching up with mates.

Josh is available for exercise physiology consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Erinn Jones is a remedial massage therapist with over 20 years of experience, specialising in compassionate and effective care for pain relief and improved mobility.

She has extensive experience across a range of therapeutic areas, including pre- and post-natal massage, infant massage, and sports and injury rehabilitation. Erinn integrates a variety of techniques into her treatments, including myofascial release, cupping, PNF stretching and mobilisation, trigger point therapy, and manual lymphatic drainage, with a particular interest in these modalities.

She is known for her warm and friendly approach and is deeply committed to helping people live more comfortably and actively by reducing pain, easing discomfort, and supporting overall wellbeing.

Erinn is available for remedial massage therapy consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Breeanna completed a Bachelor of Nutrition and Dietetics at Griffith University on the Gold Coast and is an Accredited Practising Dietitian passionate about providing nutrition advice informed by evidence-based practice and tailored to everyone’s unique needs.

Breeanna embraces diversity and inclusivity in her practice, recognising that no two people are the same and that cultural differences shape how we view health. She follows a health at every size approach and is committed to creating a non-judgemental and supportive environment for all clients.

As a generalist dietitian, Breeanna supports clients with a wide range of chronic conditions. She has a special interest in weight management, metabolic (bariatric) surgery, diabetes, paediatric nutrition, and sports dietetics.

Outside of work, Breeanna enjoys staying active and continuing to expand her knowledge within the nutrition and health space.

Breeanna is available for in-home dietitian consults throughout the Gold Coast.

Hannah is a community-based podiatrist committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centred care. She is passionate about holistic health and wellbeing and takes pride in supporting individuals of all ages and abilities to stay active, improve their health, and enhance their quality of life.

She has clinical interests in general podiatric care, biomechanics, and complex lower limb conditions. Hannah brings experience from both private practice, where she worked closely with coastal clients to design orthoses and custom footwear modifications, and high-risk settings, providing outpatient wound care.

She has a particular interest in general foot and nail care, wound management, and the management of complex podiatry-related injuries. Hannah is committed to integrating evidence-based practice with strong clinical reasoning to achieve meaningful outcomes for her patients.

Outside of work, she enjoys running, hiking, scuba diving, and strength training. She also enjoys discovering new restaurants, cooking at home, and attending live music events.

Hannah is available for podiatry consults across Brisbane.

Kylee is a speech pathologist with extensive experience working in hospitals and community settings, supporting and treating individuals with swallowing and communication difficulties.

She is committed to delivering person-centred, holistic care and values working collaboratively to support each client’s communication and swallowing goals.

Kylee is available for speech pathology consults throughout the Sunshine Coast.

Please contact us for more information about our speech pathology services.

Amy is currently studying a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy at the University of the Sunshine Coast.

Amy has a strong interest in paediatrics and aged care and enjoys learning within an interdisciplinary team to broaden her skills and knowledge across different areas of practice. She is committed to providing person-centred, evidence-based support and values building meaningful connections with clients and their families.

With a supportive approach, Amy strives to help individuals increase their independence and engage in activities that are most meaningful to them.

Outside of work and study, Amy enjoys staying active through aerial sports and reformer Pilates.

Amy is available for allied health assistance across the Sunshine Coast.

Steffi is an Accredited Exercise Physiologist who is passionate and dedicated to helping people achieve their health and wellbeing goals, improve functioning, and enhance their quality of life. She completed a Bachelor of Clinical Exercise Physiology at Queensland University of Technology.

Since graduating, she has had the opportunity to work with a wide range of individuals, supporting them through tailored, evidence-based exercise therapy.

She takes a holistic and motivational approach to care, focusing on delivering individualised interventions that support long-term change. Steffi has a particular interest in cardiovascular conditions, diabetes, metabolic syndrome, weight management, pain management, and a wide range of musculoskeletal conditions, both acute and chronic.

Outside of work, she enjoys staying active and maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

Steffi is available for in-home exercise physiology consults on the Sunshine Coast.

Breeanna trained as a physiotherapist in Auckland, New Zealand, and is passionate about helping people achieve their goals and engage in meaningful activities.

Breeanna works with a wide range of clients and has a particular interest in exercise rehabilitation and neurological conditions. With experience supporting a variety of conditions and age groups, she is committed to delivering personalised care that empowers clients to improve their independence and quality of life.

After some time away from work due to a knee injury, Breeanna is excited to be back supporting clients across the community.

Breeanna is available for in-home physiotherapy consults throughout the Gold Coast and South Brisbane.

Alyssa is currently studying a Bachelor of Occupational Therapy at the University of the Sunshine Coast.

Alyssa is passionate about helping people achieve their goals, build independence, and enhance their overall quality of life. She has a strong interest in neuro-rehabilitation and enjoys working within the aged care community. Alyssa is dedicated to providing person-centred care and empowering clients in their daily lives.
